versions.changelog:
Viral Thread Writer 1.0.1

- Updated documentation in README.md and SKILL.md for clarity and consistency.
- No logic or functional changes to the skill itself.

Initial release of Viral Thread Writer.

- Converts an idea, article, or URL into a high-engagement Twitter/X thread (5–10 tweets)
- Generates a strong hook, numbered body tweets (one idea each), and a clear CTA in every output
- Supports both Professional and Casual/Conversational tones, with auto-detection and user override
- Customizes threads for audience, topic angle, and thread length if specified
- Detects input type (idea, article, or URL) and handles error messaging for URL inputs
- Ensures all threads are structured, punchy, and optimized for engagement and readability
